dct_description_sm: Rhodiola rosea is distributed in alpine and coastal habitats of Arctic regions of North America, Asia, and Europe. Little research has been done on populations of rhodiola native to coastal Labrador.  Due to its wide ecological amplitude, rhodiola can be found growing in beach, tundra and rocky habitats. Consequently, rhodiola's variability in growth, reproduction, and morphology across these various habitats was investigated to determine how this species responds to varying habitats and environmental conditions.
